Root ISR matching-parent authoring decision: adopt contextual treatment of ONLY the exact 267 enumerated target/parent/key incidences across nine documented pairs in proposal SHA-256 b59e3044673562e3340e9714d4c1c18e6623e688716ef7f85a3fa2b6de5bdaa2.

Custody: https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/issues/2649#issuecomment-6392457577 . Archive SHA-256 b2785b960449eaf24bbe55aced95c634032e18d2bcdf5cd7afcbd355353620d7. Independent substantive assessment SHA-256 49381c9fee2cde6b98f28eba6fa2ed17f503d4c0dd6fe22dc4ea759b8864f817; exact checks SHA-256 95ea11a0160959aad51e26040433cd22d306b6190cc8d190b4a1a7b93b78c685. Root read the full assessment. This summary contains no raw coordinates, geometry or source images.

Actual original district/subdistrict source purposes and authenticated CBS hierarchy and map readings establish these specific containing-institution relationships. This is not a same-country, name-only, administrative-rank or whole-family exemption. It does not assert geometric equality, modern boundaries, sovereignty or lake allocation. All original source identities, target-specific operands, contact kinds and whole geometry hashes remain unchanged.

The proposal has 182 parent-only subjects (179 land, three water) and 85 mixed subjects (74 land, eleven water). Preserve every foreign operand: all 120 original foreign-contact subjects, including the 35 outside this proposal. No foreign predicate is removed by this decision. The complete original positive and negative source families remain intact; no unlisted pair is adopted.

The 179 parent-only land subjects may proceed to actual supported positive qualification. The three water subjects have a separate substantive researched-unresolved recommendation following actual nondecisive controlled-map application, but receive NO acceptance here. Mixed and other foreign subjects retain their separate holds and research requirements.

Independent raw full-diagnostic byte readback remains awaiting a bounded existing-owner transfer; the actual source, provenance, full 502 interpretation, original patch and whole physical evidence were independently read. This limitation is not concealed or replaced with a claimed diagnostic replay. Close that bridge before asserting complete final custody; no new producer is required for transfer.

Team 2 may author this precisely bound contextual decision through the accepted stock route. Combine any other independently reviewed semantic decisions coherently before one necessary changed-semantics diagnostic, not repeated subgroup runs. No hand-edited exclusions, invented selector ownership or weakened consumers. Original ISR remains 502 with no new root acceptance, no whole-package reinstatement and no scorecard change.
